body: I used to get points back for going to Korean beauty clinics through GuideKim, and I exchanged those points for JPYC and used them to buy a 10,000 won OLIVE YOUNG voucher. Paying with JPYC gets you 22% off, so it felt like the points I built up at the clinic turned into a double win at OLIVE YOUNG. Circulating it inside GuideKim adds up to a surprisingly big difference. I plan to do the same next time.

My sister recommended it, and that's how I gave it a try. I go to Korea a few times a year, so having an OLIVE YOUNG voucher makes buying cosmetics there much more relaxed. Honestly, only the initial identity verification gave me trouble, and I sat staring at the screen for a while…😊 But once you register, it's instant from then on. Buying with JPYC linked takes about 20% off, and some points come back afterward too, so the longer I keep at it the more I feel I'm gaining. I managed it just fine at my age, so I think people my age will be fine too.

It was my first time topping up JPYC, and honestly that was the only part that took some work. I followed the instructions and it took just under 30 minutes… But once you've bought it, it really is simple: you just show your phone screen at the register. I used 10,000 won, and compared with just paying in cash exchanged at the airport, getting 22% off with JPYC while the yen is weak is a huge help for the household budget. Get past the top-up and there's nothing to complain about.

My wife loves Korean cosmetics, so I got this as a gift. I linked JPYC to enter a gift campaign, and I ended up being able to buy the voucher at 22% off right then. She was delighted when I sent it, and it was perfect for our anniversary👍

Bought a 10,000 won voucher for an OLIVE YOUNG shopping spree~! It's money I was going to spend at OLIVE YOUNG anyway, so is there any reason not to pay with JPYC and get 22% off? All I had to do was show the barcode at the register, and the staff seemed used to it, so it was over in a second. I feel like I made my money back on small purchases alone (lol). I'll definitely buy one before my next trip to Korea🇰🇷
